===============JIS TOWER INSTRUCTIONS=============
1. Do NOT modify the player scripts, unless you know what you are doing.
2. Draw your tower in the Platform sprite
3. Draw spikes in the sprite "Spikes"
4: Draw the finish in the sprite "Winpad"
5. Look in Thumbnail to see how to make a thumbnail
6. Do NOT delete these: Player, Thumbnail, Timer, Platform
7. To change the color of the floors, go in Backdrops.

===================SUBMITTING======================
Look in the studio this project is in (called "Review Whitelist"), once you have added it there, wait until a curator has reviewed it.

======================OBJECTS======================
Platform - Yes. You know.
Spikes - Kill your player!
Moving Spikes - The same thing, but they move.
Moving Platform - Platform, but it moves.
On & Off - Beat blocks, will switch every 1 second.
Climbable - Ladders. Need I say more?
Climbable On & Climbable Off - On & Off combined with Climbable
Conveyers - Will push the player.
Strong Conveyers - Same thing, but stronger.
BouncePad - It's like a trampoline.
Teleport & Teleport Exit - Teleports you.
Wallhop Wall - Press jump on it to double jump!
Button - a button for you to press.
BAP and BAP invert - Activated when you press a button.
Key & Keydoor - Grab the key, and put it in the keydoor! 
(Keydoor Hitbox must be with keydoor for it to work)
Cannon - Launch yourself!
Zipline Start/End/Line - Zipline. What else...
Balloon - Fly up!
Jump Modifiers - Modifies your jump height.
Light changer - makes your screen bright again!
Dark changer - foggy.
Gravity Reverse/Normal - Flips the player!
Falling Platforms - Falls when the player steps on it.
Speed Changers - Modifies your speed.
Winpad - Touch it to finish the tower!
Falling Platforms - Falls when the player touches it!
Slowfall - Decreases falling speed.
Morphers - Moves a platform when the player touches a button.
Walljump Remover: Makes the player not able to walljump.
Ice: Makes the player slide!

And that's all! have fun!

Btw, remember to remove all of the COs you are not using to reduce lag.

V3.5 Changes:

COs are automatically disabled in this version. So no more spending 5 minutes disabling them.

Added Gravity Reversers, Falling Platforms, Slowfall, Morphers, Ice, Walljump Removers, Morphers and Winpads.

You can now toggle truss clipping.

Added the ability to reset by pressing R.

Instructions:

Beatblocks, beatblock trusses, keys, keydoors, keydoor hitboxes, zipline lines and buttons require you to add the "If level = 1" scripts to the empty forever loop.

On BAP, add the show block to the "when flag clicked".

More beginner-friendly collision system.

Centred frame.

Improved thumbnails.
